newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barges quoted at mostly lower levels.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barges quoted at mostly lower levels.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were moderately traded on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. Eleven barges traded on Wednesday versus none on Tuesday.
- Two barges, next week, McGregor and South (Mid-Mississippi), bid 205 percent, trade.
- Four barges, two each week November 3 and 10, McGregor and South (Mid-Mississippi), bid 205 percent, trade.
- Five barges, one each week December, Illinois River, bid 162-1/2 percent, trade.
- Two barges, next week, mid-Mississippi, no bid, offered at 210 percent, down 10 percentage points.
- Two barges, next week, lower Ohio, bid one barge at 195 percent, down 10 percentage points, offered 205 percent.
- One barge, on station, Hennepin, Illinois River, no bid, offered 205 percent, down five percentage points.
